title: Zingiber officinale tea for medicinal use
intro: Zingiber officinale tea is a traditional herbal preparation made from the dried rhizome of the ginger plant. It is widely used in herbalism for its warming and anti-inflammatory properties. This tea is commonly consumed to alleviate symptoms of nausea, digestive discomfort, and menstrual cramps. It is also known to support respiratory health and boost circulation. In many cultures, it is used as a natural remedy for colds, sore throats, and muscle pain.
